svg.text: Betalbatim pub · Concept 25 · from the shop drawing (47 m² super built-up) · 20 covers inside + 8 in the garden · 28 covers in all
PARKING BEHIND · nothing stored here · rear door is the kitchen fire exit
BEER GARDEN · 5.3 × 2.0 m · 8 covers · pergola on 2 posts + facade ledger · PVC curtains on 3 sides
kitchen exhaust: out the back, right along the wall, round the corner
fridge by the door, wok side kept clear.
Power backup on the right side, front end;
meter stays inside behind a portrait.
Kegs under the bar; glasswasher and
mixer cooler built into the back bar.
Gas, bins, AC and the kitchen exhaust in
a 0.8 m strip on the right, behind bollards;

g.text: All dimensions in metres. Left/right as you walk in from the road (road at the bottom). Dashed = overhead beams, hood, hatch and exhaust duct.
